summary: Iteration 8 MEDIUM bug FIXED and VERIFIED. The local toast overlay added to /app/frontend/app/customer-add.tsx (lines 30 destructure `toast` from useApp, 93-98 render local toast pill, 306-321 styles) now correctly displays every showToast call while the user is still on the Müşteri Ekle screen. All three scenarios pass on 390x844 mobile viewport (public preview URL): (a) tapping 'Müşteriyi Kaydet' with empty required fields → toast pill 'Ad Soyad ve Telefon zorunludur' visible at top of screen with navy background + checkmark icon (verified via testID='toast-msg', screenshot it9_toast_validation.png); (b) filling valid Ad Soyad + Telefon and saving → 'Müşteri kaydedildi' toast is visible for ~300ms before router.back() lands on /customers where the same toast continues to render via TopHeader until the AppContext 2.5s auto-clear (screenshot it9_toast_success.png); (c) invalid inputs (1-char name, empty phone) → same validation toast + red borders (rgb(220,38,38)) on both required inputs. Full end-to-end regression on the customer flow ALSO passes: Müşteriler tab empty-state message 'Henüz müşteri yok. Yukarıdaki mavi buton ile ekleyebilirsin.' renders, testID='customer-add-btn' full-width blue CTA at the top of the list correctly routes to /customer-add via history-preserving router.push (no more GO_BACK warning when nav'd through the tab), save flow persists to /api/customers, router.back() returns to /customers where the new row appears with correct card layout (avatar circle + capital letter T, name + phone, trash + chevron icons, and 'TOPLAM TEKLİF 0 Adet' / 'TOPLAM HACİM ₺0' divider row — screenshot it9_full_flow.png). Backend pytest: 41/42 pass (10.62s) — the ONE failure (TestMultiTenancy::test_userB_cannot_update_userA_quote_ekler) is a pre-existing test-order dependency in test_phase1_features.py:225 (asserts on `pytest.p1_quote_id` which is only set by an earlier test class; xdist parallel workers may split the classes across processes so the module-level global is None in worker gw1). NOT a regression from the customer-add change — the customer-add change touches ONLY frontend and is unrelated to /api/quotes. No new deprecated packages detected (pre-existing shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents RN Web 0.19 warnings still present, non-blocking). No SafeAreaView issues detected. 0 page errors during the run.

minor.issue: backend/tests/test_phase1_features.py::TestMultiTenancy::test_userB_cannot_update_userA_quote_ekler fails intermittently (order-dependent). It reads `pytest.p1_quote_id` which is set by a different test class (TestQuoteEklerCRUD.test_post_quote_with_ekler_persists at line ~150). When pytest-xdist splits classes across workers, the global is missing in worker gw1 and the assert `qid` fires. Fix: either (a) create the quote inline in this test via sessA, or (b) restructure to make sessA a class-scoped fixture and generate the quote id in the class setup. Pre-existing issue — NOT related to iteration_9 customer-add toast fix.

critical_code_review_comments: customer-add.tsx:30 — destructure `toast` from useApp() context. Clean, matches TopHeader.tsx usage.

customer-add.tsx:93-98 — local toast overlay rendered as first child of SafeAreaView with pointerEvents='none' (prevents overlay from swallowing taps), zIndex:9999, elevation:12. Correctly matches TopHeader.tsx:18-23 visual style (navy background, checkmark icon, white text pill).
customer-add.tsx:306-321 — styles.toast and styles.toastText are self-contained; use theme.colors.navy and theme.shadow.md just like the source in TopHeader. No divergence risk.
The fix is truly minimal: only 3 additions (context destructure + JSX overlay + 2 style rules). AppContext.tsx unchanged. TopHeader.tsx unchanged. No side effects on any other screen.

customer-add.tsx:72-78 — edit/add branch STILL both call api.createCustomer (upsert-key based on companyId+firma). This is a carry-over LOW note from iter8: if a user edits the 'Ad Soyad / Firma Ünvanı' the upsert key changes and a duplicate row is created rather than updating the original. Not touched in this iteration per the user's 'sadece bu iki ekran / minimal' constraint.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The iter8 MEDIUM toast-invisibility bug on /customer-add is FIXED. The fix is a local toast overlay inside customer-add.tsx (not a global ToastHost). If future testers add MORE screens that skip TopHeader (custom headers), they will hit the same class of bug — either reuse TopHeader, add a local overlay like customer-add.tsx does, or push main agent to extract a <ToastHost/> into app/_layout.tsx. Backend regression suite: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` gives 41/42 stable pass (1 pre-existing order-dep flake in test_phase1_features.py:225 that also existed in iter8 — iter8's 42/42 report was against a single-worker or lucky ordering; parallel xdist can split it). Frontend UI recipe: register user via page.evaluate fetch → PATCH /auth/me with country/currency/tax_label/onboarding_completed → POST /companies → localStorage.setItem('session_token_v1', RAW_TOKEN) → goto /(tabs)/customers → use testIDs customer-add-btn, cadd-name, cadd-phone, cadd-email, cadd-company, cadd-address, cadd-save, toast-msg. Delete/chevron TouchableOpacity buttons render as div[role='button'] on RN Web, not <button> — use [data-testid^='delete-cust-'] div selectors (no button tag).
